verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS communications platform with desktop and mobile apps, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented setting to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. Application permission scopes are an adjacent access-control feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
